# Microsoft cvtres regression fixture

`msvc-cvtres-smoke.syso.fixture` is the unmodified public resource object from GitHub Actions job 125295578996, artifact 13144563586, SHA-256 `c16d8131148043b04d44d642e89329f6fb55c32b0067b381253af5ff1fdfb868`. The `.fixture` suffix prevents Go from automatically linking it. The object was generated from the repository's public icon, fixed manifest and disposable `DillaSmoke` version metadata before the bootstrap configuration was passed to Go. It contains ephemeral GitHub-hosted runner and Visual Studio tool paths in its debug section; it contains no bootstrap config or key material. It has one unreferenced static absolute `@comp.id` symbol rejected by Go 1.27.3's internal PE linker. The regression test checks the exact captured bytes and relocation targets.
